name: Tokyo Disney Hotels (including Fantasy Springs Hotel)
intro: The hotels run by Tokyo Disney Resort, including Tokyo DisneySea Fantasy Springs Hotel inside the park. Rooms open four months ahead, and the most sought-after hotels and room types can sell out within minutes.

facts.bookAhead: Four months: rooms open at 11:00 on the same date four months before

statusNote: Read from the official Tokyo Disney Resort hotel reservation page. Tokyo DisneySea Fantasy Springs Hotel has its own page, which we have not checked separately.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: Fantasy Springs Hotel is a big topic, but far fewer visitors book a Disney hotel than a park ticket.
difficultyNote: Travel guides report Fantasy Springs Hotel rooms selling out within minutes of the 11:00 release; other Disney hotels last longer.
bookingSteps: Create a MyDisney account for the Tokyo Disney Resort Online Reservations & Tickets site.
Have every guest's name ready. Each room needs a different guest name, and names can't be changed after booking.
Be logged in before 11:00 Japan time, four months before your stay. Fantasy Springs Hotel has its own reservation page.
Book up to three rooms for up to five nights in one go.
Pay a deposit by credit card when you book: ¥30,000 per room at Luxury and Deluxe hotels, ¥15,000 at Moderate and Value hotels.
Pay the rest when you check out.
visitorTips: Cancellation fees start 14 days before your stay and rise to the full deposit from the day before. They come out of your deposit.
Changing dates counts as cancelling and booking again, so fees apply and the new dates may not be available.
If the same date doesn't exist four months earlier, rooms open on the 1st of the next month. The official example: an October 31 stay opens on July 1 at 11:00.
Help by phone from overseas: +81-50-3090-2743, 10:00 to 15:00 Japan time.

faq.q: When can I book a Tokyo Disney hotel?
faq.a: From 11:00 Japan time four months before the date of your stay.

faq.q: Does the same rule apply to Fantasy Springs Hotel?
faq.a: Fantasy Springs Hotel has its own reservation page. Check it on the official site before you book.

sources.quote: Reservations are accepted from 11:00 a.m. four months before your planned day of stay
The reservation deposit for stays should be paid using a credit card.
